text:
eva: Quick perf ask — can someone run smoke + perf on phoenix-7B-qlora? Need p50/p95 and throughput for 512 context and 2048 token streams. Also compare before/after the kv-optim change. Batch sizes: 1/4/8. Target ded-1 (A100S).

sam: on it. I assume same quant config as last onboarding run (int8-qkv)?

eva: yes, same as onboarding: q4f16 fallback. Please include baseline from tag v2026-03-05.

priya: I'll kick off the runs. Command I'm using:```
./bench_runner --model phoenix-7b-qlora --tag onb-phx --seq 512 --stream-tokens 2048 --batch 1,4,8 --profile --out artifacts/phoenix-vs-kv-optim.csv
```

bench-bot: run started on ded-1 (a100s-80gb). Job id: run-9231. ETA ~18m.

ryan: heads up — if p95 reg >5% ping me, will allocate extra capacity to re-run with alternate cuda kernels.

bench-bot: run-9231 finished. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/run-9231

priya: quick summary: p50 (batch1) baseline 12.3ms -> new 13.1ms (+6.5%); p95 baseline 48.1ms -> new 50.9ms (+5.8%). batch4 throughput +18% with kv-cache warm. full CSV in artifacts link.

sam: thanks. Can you attach flamegraphs and nvprof so we can get kernel breakdown?

priya: uploaded flamegraph + nvprof: https://artifacts.redwood/run-9231/trace . Major delta is an extra memcpy for kv-optim in cold start; warm runs look fine.

eva: since p95 reg >5% we should open a bug with reproducer + full logs and assign to runtime/perf. memcpy sounds like the hot path to optimize (or async copy).

ryan: created PERF-712 and linked a small memcpy-reduction patch: https://github.com/redwood/reimpl/pull/411 . Please attach the bench CSV to the ticket.

priya: added CSV + flamegraph to PERF-712 and re-ran canary with the patch — p95 now 47.3ms (1.6% faster than baseline). Marking onboarding green and updating the model catalog.

eva: perfect. Can someone publish a short note in onboarding docs and drop the artifacts link in the model card?

sam: I'll update the model card and add a short note about kv-optim caveats. PR: https://github.com/redwood/models/pull/99

bench-bot: model card updated by sam — https://models.redwood/phoenix-7b-qlora
